info.name: Northstar Slack — semantic search verification
info.description: Live tests against Express, the OpenRouter Qwen3 Embedding 8B model, and MongoDB Vector Search. No mocks in this collection.

exec: pm.test("All 50 conversations embedded with configured model", () => { pm.expect(b.ready).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.documents).to.eql(50); pm.expect(b.embeddedDocuments).to.eql(50); pm.expect(b.model).to.eql("qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b"); pm.expect(b.dimensions).to.eql(4096); });

query.value: How can we replace an API credential without interrupting callers?

exec: pm.test("JSON array with exactly 20 results", () => { pm.expect(rows).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(rows.length).to.eql(20); });
pm.test("Scores are numeric and sorted highest first", () => rows.forEach((r,i) => { pm.expect(r.score).to.be.a("number").within(0,1); if(i) pm.expect(r.score).to.be.at.most(rows[i-1].score); }));

pm.test("Source context retained without raw vectors", () => rows.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.id).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(r.messages.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(r).not.to.have.property("embedding"); pm.expect(r.channel).to.be.a("string"); }));
pm.test("Relevant conversation appears in the first five", () => pm.expect(rows.slice(0,5).some(r=>["eng-09"].includes(r.id))).to.eql(true));
